name: AS7341 / AS7343 / TCS3448 Spectral Color Sensor
description: The `as734x` component allows you to use the AS7341 ([datasheet](https://look.ams-osram.com/m/24266a3e584de4db/original/AS7341-DS000504.pdf), [Adafruit](https://www.adafruit.com/product/4698)) and AS7343 ([datasheet](https://look.ams-osram.com/m/5f2d27fff9a874d2/original/AS7343-14-Channel-Multi-Spectral-Sensor.pdf)) spectral color sensors with ESPHome. The TCS3448 ([datasheet](https://look.ams-osram.com/m/1c24b057e65ee61e/original/TCS3448-14-Channel-multi-spectral-sensor.pdf)) is supported as well: it replaces the AS7343 and shares its channels, register map and calibration, so everything written below about the AS7343 applies to it too. The sensor is selected with the `type` option. The [I²C Bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/) is required to be set up in your configuration for this sensor to work.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The I²C address of the sensor. Defaults to `0x39`, or to `0x59` when `type` is `TCS3448`, which answers on a different address than the AS7343.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The I²C address of the sensor. Defaults to `0x39`, or to `0x59` when `type` is `TCS3448`, which answers on a different address than the AS7343.

config_entries.label: I2C ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID of the [I²C Component](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/) if you want to use multiple I²C buses.

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: The interval to read the sensor. Defaults to `60s`.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID for this component. Set it when you have more than one `as734x` sensor.

config_entries.label: Astep
config_entries.description: The length of one integration step in increments of 2.78µs. Defaults to `599`. Must be between `0` and `65534`.

config_entries.label: Atime
config_entries.description: The number of integration steps. Defaults to `29`. Must be between `0` and `255`.

config_entries.label: Calibration
config_entries.description: Corrections applied while converting raw counts to basic counts. See [Calibration](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as734x/#calibration) below.

config_entries.label: Channel Correction
config_entries.description: One factor per channel, in the order given under [Channel Order](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as734x/#channel-order). The list length must match the model: 10 values for the AS7341, 13 for the AS7343 and TCS3448. Defaults to the manufacturer's factors for the AS7343 and TCS3448, and to all ones for the AS7341.

config_entries.label: Dark Current
config_entries.description: One dark current offset per channel, in basic counts, subtracted before the corrections are applied. Same length rule as `channel_correction`. Defaults to all zeroes.

config_entries.label: Glass Attenuation Factor
config_entries.description: A single factor compensating for any cover glass in front of the sensor. Defaults to `1.0`, meaning no cover.

config_entries.label: Gain
config_entries.description: The gain used by the device. A higher gain may be more suitable for lower-light environments. Defaults to `X8`.

config_entries.label: Gain
config_entries.description: The gain used by the device. A higher gain may be more suitable for lower-light environments. Defaults to `X8`.

config_entries.label: Normalize Basic Counts
config_entries.description: Divide every basic count by a common reference, so the published values describe the shape of the spectrum rather than its strength. Defaults to `NONE`.

options.label: NONE
options.description: publish the basic counts as they are.

options.label: ALL
options.description: divide by the largest basic count of any channel.

options.label: BANDS
options.description: divide by the largest basic count among the visible bands, ignoring clear and nir.

options.label: CLEAR
options.description: divide by the basic count of the clear channel.
